paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the learning rate of the reward model during training, with the x-axis representing the training step, ranging from 0 to 1400 on a linear scale, and the y-axis representing the learning rate, ranging from 0.00 to 2.00 in units of 1e-6 on a linear scale. The single blue line, marked with solid circles and a solid line style, begins at a learning rate of approximately 0.0001 at step 0, rises sharply to a peak value of 2.00e-6 at step 0, and then gradually declines over the course of the training steps, reaching a value near 0.0001 at step 1400.
